blurb: Arcadia Golf Course is an 18-hole par 3 course measuring 1,947 yards, suitable for beginners and short game practice. It features Poa annua and bentgrass greens with many bunkers and is open daily with lights for late-night play. The course also offers a Golf Learning Center for juniors and a PGA-certified "Get Golf Ready" program for adults.
